description: vpc/v1: a VPC inside a single account. account_id is filled by the framework when the upstream account becomes ready. `tags` is an OPTIONAL field (a non-breaking v1 evolution the publish linter auto-allows — no kind_version bump).

account_id.description: Provider 12-digit account id this VPC lives in.

tags.description: Optional free-form tags (added in a non-breaking v1 evolution).

config_schema.description: vpc/v1 operational config (a provider config document): the default S3 bucket flow logs land in. A per-(kind, kind_version) config — vpc/v1's default is separate from vpc/v2's.

flow_logs_bucket.description: S3 bucket VPC flow logs are written to.
